product_launches.description: Six Senses is launching The Yin Way Retreat – The Way of a Woman, a women’s wellness retreat combining modern science, Traditional Chinese Medicine, yoga, meditation, workshops, and personalized treatments. The retreat will be offered at Six Senses Kanuhura in the Maldives from October 1–4, 2026, and Six Senses Kyoto in Japan from December 11–14, 2026.
